This study establishes a practical and scalable electrode-level design principle, guided by the mechanically driven degradation mechanism under fast-charging conditions, for developing durable, high-energy, fast-charging LIBs. For practical in­ dustrial implementation, the proposed bilayer electrode design is ex­ pected to be applicable to dual-slot die coating (wet-on-wet) processes used in industrial battery manufacturing.
